messages:
Anya: Quick sync — OptKit delivery milestone check. Where are we on quant recs + batching for canary? I need owner + ETA for roll tomorrow.
Matt: I can own the quant recs doc. PR in progress: https://github.com/redwood/optkit/pull/814
Diego: FYI perf regression flagged in staging by qa-bot (latency spike on long context). link: https://ci.internal/reports/890
qa-bot: regression-alert: commit 7f3b2c increased tail latency 18% on sequence_length=8k. Traces: /ci/890/trace
Jules: @Matt please add recommended qconfig for A10->A10G fallback. We saw bad accuracy drop with int8 on the summarizer.
Matt: noted, adding quant profile + evaluation results. ETA 5h.
Kim: Batching/caching suggestions — should we enable prefix cache for chat flows in canary? That reduces tokens by ~20% on our sample.
Anya: yes enable prefix cache for canary, but keep a flag so we can toggle quickly. Owner: @Kim
Diego: dependency: eng-runtime needs a small routing API change to pass variant tags. @eng-runtime FYI
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: optkit/canary v0.12 => 3061234600; health checks enabled
Jules: Code review ping @Matt on PR 814 - left comments about quant eval harness.
Matt: responding to CRs now, pushing a small fix for dtype handling.
Anya: OK — final checklist: Matt (quant docs + PR), Kim (cache flag), Eng-runtime (routing tag) — blockers? If none, proceed with canary at 3061234600. :thumbsup:
Diego: no blockers from infra side.
qa-bot: smoke results (post-deploy): no functional regressions on core tests. latency tail still +2% — monitoring alert set.
Anya: good. If tail >5% we'll rollback. Thanks everyone.
